facts.claim: Senso-ji, Kaminarimon and the Nakamise shopping street form the central traditional visitor route in Asakusa.
facts.sourceHeading: An iconic Tokyo temple complex and town brimming with tradition
facts.evidenceExcerpt: an area centered around Sensoji Temple with Kaminarimon

facts.claim: Nakamise is the shopping approach between Kaminarimon and the temple main hall, with souvenir stalls and snacks.
facts.sourceHeading: Thunder gate, temples and traditional theme parks
facts.evidenceExcerpt: wander through the lively and extensive Nakamise shopping street

facts.claim: Asakusa Station is served by the Ginza, Toei Asakusa and Tobu Skytree lines.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Asakusa Station is on Tokyo Metro’s Ginza Line
